page.overview:
What is Super Heroes?

Super Heroes is a licensed theme introduced in January 2012, although, in reality, 2011. Certain promotional sets were available in the Summer and early December of 2011. It currently features a grand total of over 30, based on the DC Universe and Marvel comic books and movies. Since 2019, the "Super Heroes" logo has been dropped from all DC and Marvel sets.

Both Marvel and DC previously had LEGO sets based on their flagship heroes, Spider-Man and Batman, respectively. The former had sets based off of the two then-released films directed by Sam Raimi, and had originated as a Studios set prior to spinning off into a seperate theme. The latter, contrarily, was based off of the comics, with influence from Batman: The Animated Series and Tim Burton's films, and was set in its own continuity not pertaining to any specific era of Batman.

There were nine DC Universe sets (which focus on the Batman, Superman, and Green Lantern series with guest appearance by Wonder Woman and Flash) released in January 2012, with two promotional ones released in May. 23 new minifigures were introduced in the DC Universe subtheme in January.

The Marvel collection focuses on the Marvel Cinematic Universe, X-Men, and Ultimate Spider-Man.
